constant_recognition_followup.rationale: Normal constant moves that are a shifted byte plus 255 can be recognized before reload and split into scheduler-visible instructions after reload. Keep the original general late-reload synthesis indivisible. This reproduces the arithmetic 655 and mask 65535 sites while retaining pooled message arguments.
constant_recognition_followup.invalidated_hypothesis: Pseudo-register versus ABI-argument destination does not explain pooling. Initial RTL puts message arguments in pseudos too; CSE replaces arithmetic UNSPECs carrying REG_EQUAL with plain constants, which reversed the prediction.
constant_recognition_followup.split_all_late_constants: Correct arithmetic sequences, but introduces unwanted moves before loads at early state accesses. Retaining atomic late synthesis restores those orders and still matches the complete Djinn helper.
